text_block_list.text:
I was talking with Yamanin Zephyr
in the trainer's office, when—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Somehow... it feels like a violent storm is raging inside my head...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You can mitigate a fierce storm raging across the field
somewhat by taking shelter in a grove of trees, but...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: There was obviously no grove of trees inside my head...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I hope it calms down soon...
Owwwww...
Yamanin Zephyr seems to be suffering from a headache.
